generationInputs.prompt:
Create a visual storyboard as a SINGLE IMAGE arranged in a 3x3 grid layout (3 columns, 3 rows) showing a 9-second cinematic sequence. 

GRID LAYOUT INSTRUCTIONS:
- The image must be a single composite image divided into a 3x3 grid of 9 equal panels.
- Maintain a consistent visual style, soft diffused lighting, and cinematic atmosphere across all panels.
- Characters and settings must look consistent from panel to panel.

SCENE DETAILS (using reference image f2a48ab3-c040-4086-a831-c684440684c3 for robot and white room):
- Character 1: White and black futuristic robot with green glowing smiley face visor.
- Character 2: One large fluffy white dog wearing a long teal silk scarf.
- Character 3: Three small identical white fluffy dogs.
- Character 4: One tiny brown chihuahua with its tongue out to the side.

FRAMES:
Panel 1: The robot floats alone in the minimalist white zero-G chamber.
Panel 2: The large white dog with the teal scarf drifts gracefully into the frame from the right.
Panel 3: One small white fluffy dog floats up from the bottom of the frame.
Panel 4: A second small white dog joins from the left side, levitating naturally.
Panel 5: The third small white dog enters from the top, completing the white dog group.
Panel 6: Close-up on the tiny brown chihuahua drifting near the camera with its tongue out.
Panel 7: The entire group (robot, large dog, 4 small dogs) orbits slowly together in a wide shot.
Panel 8: A dynamic orbital camera view capturing the motion of the floating ensemble.
Panel 9: A final symmetric tableau of all characters perfectly positioned in the glowing white void.
